data.q: Which middleware must be added to the request pipeline to enable authentication in ASP.NET Core?
data.e: UseAuthentication adds the authentication middleware that processes the request's authentication schemes.

data.q: What is the default authentication scheme used by ASP.NET Core Identity for cookie-based authentication?
data.e: Identity.Application is the default scheme name for the application cookie used by ASP.NET Core Identity.

data.q: Which attribute is used to restrict access to a controller or action to authenticated users only?
How do you specify a policy-based authorization requirement in an [Authorize] attribute?
data.e: Policy name is passed via the Policy property of the Authorize attribute.

data.q: In ASP.NET Core, which class is used to represent a JWT token validation parameters?
data.e: TokenValidationParameters configures how JWT tokens are validated (issuer, audience, signing key, etc.).

data.q: Which method on IServiceCollection registers the default Identity services with Entity Framework Core stores?
data.e: AddIdentity with AddEntityFrameworkStores sets up Identity using EF Core.

data.q: What is the purpose of the 'RequireAuthenticatedUser' policy in the default authorization configuration?
o: Ensures that only authenticated users can access the resource
Requires the user to have a specific role
data.e: The built-in RequireAuthenticatedUser policy simply checks that the user is authenticated.

data.q: When using cookie authentication, which option sets the cookie's SameSite attribute to 'Lax'?
data.e: SameSiteMode.Lax is assigned to the SameSite property of the cookie options.

data.q: Which interface must a custom authorization handler implement?
data.e: Custom handlers implement IAuthorizationHandler (or derive from AuthorizationHandler<TRequirement>).

data.q: How do you configure an OpenID Connect authentication scheme in Startup.ConfigureServices?
data.e: AddAuthentication returns an AuthenticationBuilder on which you call AddOpenIdConnect.

data.q: What does the 'AddAuthorization' method allow you to do?
data.e: AddAuthorization provides an AuthorizationOptions instance to add policies.

data.q: Which claim type is commonly used to store a user's role in the ClaimsPrincipal?
In a Razor Page, how do you programmatically check if the current user satisfies a policy?
data.e: IAuthorizationService.AuthorizeAsync returns an AuthorizationResult indicating success or failure.

data.q: What is the effect of calling 'app.UseAuthorization()' before 'app.UseAuthentication()' in the middleware pipeline?
o: Authorization will run before authentication, causing the user to be unauthenticated when policies are evaluated
No effect; order does not matter
The application will throw a startup exception
data.e: Authentication must run first to populate the user principal; otherwise authorization sees an anonymous user.
